themes_detail.label: Street vendor enforcement surge
themes_detail.summary: Vendor Enforcement complaints spiked to 7 this week versus 0.1 weekly average over 8 weeks—a 5500% increase (z-score: 20.79)—signaling either new enforcement activity, vendor concentration, or emerging permit/licensing conflicts in Sheepshead Bay.
evidence: 7 vendor enforcement complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.1 weekly baseline (5500% spike)
Z-score of 20.79 indicates statistically extreme deviation
Highest-ranked spike across all 311 categories in the district
reporting_angles: Interview DSNY or enforcement officials about why Sheepshead Bay saw sudden vendor enforcement blitz
Talk to street vendors (food carts, goods sellers) about new permits, fines, or confiscations

themes_detail.label: Park misuse and rule violations
themes_detail.summary: Violation of Park Rules complaints jumped to 3 this week from 0.2 weekly average—a 1100% spike (z-score: 6.35)—suggesting new safety or use conflicts at district parks, possibly tied to seasonal changes or construction.
evidence: 3 park rule violation complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average (1100% spike)
Aligns with emerging safety or usage pattern shift
reporting_angles: Identify which parks are generating complaints (likely Coney Island Ave or Bay parks)
Interview Parks Department about new enforcement or behavioral issues

themes_detail.label: Street noise complaints accelerate
themes_detail.summary: Noise - Street/Sidewalk complaints surged to 23 this week versus 7.8 weekly average—a 197% increase (z-score: 4.78)—indicating a new source of construction, commercial activity, or street activity in the neighborhood.
evidence: 23 street noise complaints THIS WEEK vs. 7.8 weekly average (197% spike)
Distinct from residential noise—suggests outdoor/commercial source
reporting_angles: Canvass Avenue U, Coney Island Ave, and Gravesend Ave for construction or new vendor activity
Check DOB permits for recently filed demolition or alteration work (543 total filings in 90 days)

themes_detail.label: Overgrown trees and branch hazards
themes_detail.summary: Overgrown Tree/Branches complaints rose to 10 this week from 2.8 weekly average—a 264% spike (z-score: 5.21)—indicating seasonal growth or deferred Parks Department maintenance creating safety hazards on streets and sidewalks.
evidence: 10 overgrown tree complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.8 weekly average (264% spike)
reporting_angles: Document specific street locations with hazardous branches or obstructed sightlines
Interview Parks Department about pruning schedules and backlog

themes_detail.label: Elevator outages spike in buildings
themes_detail.summary: Elevator complaints jumped to 4 last week from 0.2 weekly average—a 1500% spike (z-score: 8.66)—suggesting potential system failures in multi-family or commercial buildings, likely affecting elderly residents and mobility-challenged tenants.
evidence: 4 elevator complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly average (1500% spike)
High human impact for seniors and disabled residents in aging buildings
reporting_angles: Identify which buildings reported elevator failures and verify repair timelines with DOB
Interview residents about impacts on elderly tenants; connect to broader building maintenance issues
